beats.headline: You have merch
beats.text: For the record: the subject was in the first group led into the main ballroom, a mushroom guy Crawler Carl had only seen in passing, afraid of Elle for some unknown reason. When Ferdinand turns up in a tall hat, Elle says it looks like a hat designed to look like Horton the mushroom guy over there. Hey, Horton, come here, she shouts. You have merch. From across the room, the mushroom guy lifts a middle finger at her. Elle keeps laughing. I love that guy, she says.

beats.headline: The second-to-last act
beats.text: The second-to-last act appears on stage: the mushroom guy, Horton, with an acoustic guitar missing a string. It is the same guitar Britney is meant to play for the final act. He tunes it for a long while, and Queen Imogen grows impatient. This is 'Wonderwall,' he says, and starts to play. Crawler Donut's reaction is OMG. Crawler Carl laughs at the absurdity of it all: a mushroom dude playing a poorly-tuned guitar and singing his cat's favourite song, with the whole universe watching.

beats.headline: I guess I'm done
beats.text: Ka-Blam. The building shakes, tables fall, the buffet collapses and scatters the hunters. The subject pauses his song. The floor tiles have shattered like windshield glass, and near the exits they are simply gone, leaving burning, jagged holes. Crawlers standing over the gaps do not fall through. Samantha, somewhere in the castle, reports by chat that she has chomped down on the soul crystals. On stage, the subject speaks: Uh, I guess I'm done. He goes offstage.

beats.headline: The Wonderwall guy
beats.text: Horton, crawler, is dead. The notice comes from Crawler Donut, reeling off the dead to Crawler Carl after the fight: Firas, Gwen, and Horton, the Wonderwall guy, and the Popovs. Poor Horton, too, she says; it is always sad to lose a fellow musician. Elle is really upset about it. Crawler Donut thinks Elle feels bad about making fun of him all the time.

beats.headline: A really good singer
beats.text: Crawler Donut's account of the floor, set down for her fans, lists what went wrong. Firas died. Gideon died. Gwendolyn Duet died. This mushroom guy who was a really good singer died. She does not give his name. The Popov brothers died too, and then turned into babies and were kicked out of the game, which made everyone happy.
